title: plume — horticulture

sentences.sentence: ...broad straw hats decorated with ostrich plumes.

sentences.sentence: She had a brown spring jacket and brown cargo pants. Her brown hair was pulled into a pony tail and she wore a lavender poncho underneath.
sentences.translation: 茜尔维穿的是棕色春季夹克和棕色大口袋裤子，而她的棕色头发则被编成了个马尾辫，还穿着薰衣草色的雨披。

sentences.sentence: Sign up for the Cave of the Winds tour, which begins after you change into a complimentary yellow poncho and sandals (trust us, you'll need 'em).
sentences.translation: 报名参加风之洞之旅吧，你将会获赠一个黄色雨披和一双凉拖（相信我，你会用得到）。

sentences.sentence: Out with every theory of human behavior, from linguistics to sociology.
sentences.translation: 从语言学、社会学的人类行为原理里解脱吧。

sentences.sentence: It took three hours for the doctor of linguistics to tell us this. Again I quit.
sentences.translation: 关于这一点，这个语言学博士足足讲了三个小时，我再次退出了。

sentences.sentence: Then we have research center in Grenoble, France where the focus is all on linguistics, machine learning.
sentences.translation: 我们在法国格勒诺布尔也有研究中心,研究重点是语言学和机器学习。

sentences.sentence: I don't know the philology side, I don't know what disables to metaphysical questions.
sentences.translation: 我不知道者从语言学上来说对不对，我也不懂从形而上学角度看,有什么问题。

sentences.sentence: She lay back in the tub.

translations.translation: 预感, 先兆, 预兆

sentences.sentence: She waited for news with a grim sense of foreboding .
sentences.translation: 她等待着消息，心里有一种不祥的预感。

sentences.sentence: It was a foretaste of things to come.
sentences.translation: 这是未来之事的预演。

sentences.sentence: ...the presupposition that human life must be sustained for as long as possible.
sentences.translation: ...必须让人的生命得以尽可能延长的这种假设。

sentences.sentence: Ann: There's no longer the preconception that men cannot arrange flowers.
sentences.translation: 认为男人不能插花的偏见已经不复存在了。

sentences.sentence: I had also been identified as 1992’s character problem candidate; that made the media vulnerable to whatever dirt they were handed to support the preconception.
sentences.translation: 我还被看成是1992年有“品格问题”的候选人；媒体自然更容易接受别人“报料”的任何流言蜚语，以迎合其早已存在的偏见。

sentences.sentence: But it is only by fully sharing who we really are that we can begin to bring down the walls of preconception and challenge people to get to know us before deciding what we are.
sentences.translation: 但是只有完全展示出真正的自我，我们才能够推倒偏见之墙，才能够要求人们先了解我们再作判断。

sentences.sentence: In dreams one may presage the future.
sentences.translation: 一个人能从梦中预感将来。

sentences.sentence: The talents and virtues which were displayed in that great struggle were a sure presage of all that has since followed.
sentences.translation: 在那场伟大的斗争中所展示的天资和美德无疑已经预示了其后发生的一切。

sentences.sentence: Martin's departure is therefore momentous and historic, but may also presage changes to the post, one with which the British public is largely unfamiliar.
sentences.translation: 马丁的离职重要且具历史意义，但可能也预示着这一职位会有所改变，英国公众对这个职位并不甚熟悉。

sentences.sentence: The car won’t start. Do you think it’s an omen?
sentences.translation: 汽车发动不起来。你觉得这是某种预兆吗？

sentences.sentence: It's long been regarded as pseudoscience, but precognition–that is, the ability to not just predict but to actually perceive the future–is getting a fair shake in some scientific circles lately.
sentences.translation: 长期以来，人们一直认为预知是伪科学，但最近在某些科学家圈子里，预知——不仅是预测还包括准确感知未来的能力——开始得到了一定的认可。

sentences.sentence: Cornell Professor Daryl Bem conducted nine experiments on more than 1,000 Cornell students to test the human mind powers of premonition and precognition。
sentences.translation: 康奈尔大学教授达里尔-贝姆对1000多名康奈尔大学学生做了9项实验，以测试人类预感和预知能力。

sentences.sentence: It is my orexis, without any aim.
sentences.translation: 那只是我心底的欲望，没有任何目的。

sentences.sentence: Do you feel hungry frequently? Is orexis bloom a good thing?
sentences.translation: 最近时常感觉饿吗？食欲旺盛是好事吗？

sentences.sentence: ...the parable of the Good Samaritan.
sentences.translation: …善良的撒玛利亚人的寓言。

sentences.sentence: The area has a long tradition of horticulture.
sentences.translation: 园艺是这个地区源远流长的传统。

sentences.sentence: Thus, to earn a Plant Science merit badge, a scout can choose between agronomy, horticulture, or field botany.
sentences.translation: 因此，为了赚取植物科学奖章，一个童子军可以选择农学，园艺，或田野植物学。

sentences.sentence: All volunteers first go through orientation sessions, which are followed with one of three more specific training tracks:horticulture, “Ambassadors, ” and animal care.
sentences.translation: 所有的志愿者先要通过新成员训练，然后再在三种特殊训练规划（园艺、“大使”和动物照料）中选择一种。

text:
英语词汇 · GRE · 第 282 单元

plume
音标：英 /pluːm/  美 /plum/
n. 羽毛
短语：mantle plume — [地质]地幔柱
短语：borrowed plumes — n. 借得的漂亮衣服装门面；靠别人得来的声望
短语：smoke plume — 烟流，烟羽
例句：...broad straw hats decorated with ostrich plumes.
…装饰着鸵鸟毛的宽沿草帽。

fledgling
音标：英 /'fledʒlɪŋ/  美 /'flɛdʒlɪŋ/
n. 羽毛初长的雏鸟, 刚会飞的幼鸟, 无经验的人, 初出茅庐的人
例句：...when fledglings are almost ready to leave the nests.
…当刚长出羽毛的雏鸟差不多可以离开鸟巢的时候。

panache
音标：英 /pə'næʃ/  美 /pə'næʃ/
n. 羽饰, 华丽

poncho
音标：英 /'pɒn(t)ʃəʊ/  美 /'pɑntʃo/
n. 雨布
例句：The brightly polished granite surface depicts the poncho wearing riflemen as they climbed up a Korean hill.
明亮的抛光花岗岩表面描绘了穿着雨披的步兵爬上了一座韩国的小山。
例句：She had a brown spring jacket and brown cargo pants. Her brown hair was pulled into a pony tail and she wore a lavender poncho underneath.
茜尔维穿的是棕色春季夹克和棕色大口袋裤子，而她的棕色头发则被编成了个马尾辫，还穿着薰衣草色的雨披。
例句：Sign up for the Cave of the Winds tour, which begins after you change into a complimentary yellow poncho and sandals (trust us, you'll need 'em).
报名参加风之洞之旅吧，你将会获赠一个黄色雨披和一双凉拖（相信我，你会用得到）。

ombrometer
n. 雨量计, 雨计

solecism
音标：英 /'sɒlɪsɪz(ə)m/  美 /'sɑlɪsɪzəm/
n. 语法错误, 谬误, 失礼
例句：a social solecism
社交上的失礼

linguistics
音标：英 /lɪŋ'gwɪstɪks/  美 /lɪŋ'ɡwɪstɪks/
n. 语言学
短语：cognitive linguistics — 认知语言学
短语：applied linguistics — 应用语言学；运用语言学
短语：corpus linguistics — 语料库语言学
短语：computational linguistics — 计算语言学
短语：social linguistics — 社会语言学
短语：text linguistics — 话语语言学
短语：linguistics and applied linguistics — 语言学及应用语言学
短语：general linguistics — 普通语言学
短语：historical linguistics — 历史语言学
短语：comparative linguistics — 比较语言学
例句：Out with every theory of human behavior, from linguistics to sociology.
从语言学、社会学的人类行为原理里解脱吧。
例句：It took three hours for the doctor of linguistics to tell us this. Again I quit.
关于这一点，这个语言学博士足足讲了三个小时，我再次退出了。
例句：Then we have research center in Grenoble, France where the focus is all on linguistics, machine learning.
我们在法国格勒诺布尔也有研究中心,研究重点是语言学和机器学习。

philology
音标：英 /fɪ'lɒlədʒɪ/  美 /fɪ'lɑlədʒi/
n. 语言学, 文献学
例句：I don't know the philology side, I don't know what disables to metaphysical questions.
我不知道者从语言学上来说对不对，我也不懂从形而上学角度看,有什么问题。

etymology
音标：英 /,etɪ'mɒlədʒɪ/  美 /,ɛtɪ'mɑlədʒi/
n. 语源, 语源学

tub
音标：英 /tʌb/  美 /tʌb/
n. 浴盆
短语：in the tub — 破产
短语：bath tub — 浴盆；盆形燃烧室
短语：hot tub — 热水澡桶；热水浴缸
例句：She lay back in the tub.
她仰靠在浴缸里。

foreboding
音标：英 /fɔː'bəʊdɪŋ/  美 /fɔr'bodɪŋ/
n. 预感, 先兆, 预兆
例句：She waited for news with a grim sense of foreboding .
她等待着消息，心里有一种不祥的预感。

foretaste
音标：英 /'fɔːteɪst/
n. 预示
例句：It was a foretaste of things to come.
这是未来之事的预演。

presupposition
音标：美 /'prisʌpə'zɪʃən/
n. 预想, 假设
例句：...the presupposition that human life must be sustained for as long as possible.
...必须让人的生命得以尽可能延长的这种假设。

preconception
音标：英 /priːkən'sepʃ(ə)n/  美 /,prikən'sɛpʃən/
n. 预想, 偏见
例句：Ann: There's no longer the preconception that men cannot arrange flowers.
认为男人不能插花的偏见已经不复存在了。
例句：I had also been identified as 1992’s character problem candidate; that made the media vulnerable to whatever dirt they were handed to support the preconception.
我还被看成是1992年有“品格问题”的候选人；媒体自然更容易接受别人“报料”的任何流言蜚语，以迎合其早已存在的偏见。
例句：But it is only by fully sharing who we really are that we can begin to bring down the walls of preconception and challenge people to get to know us before deciding what we are.
但是只有完全展示出真正的自我，我们才能够推倒偏见之墙，才能够要求人们先了解我们再作判断。

presage
音标：英 /'presɪdʒ/  美 /'prɛsɪdʒ/
n. 预兆
例句：In dreams one may presage the future.
一个人能从梦中预感将来。
例句：The talents and virtues which were displayed in that great struggle were a sure presage of all that has since followed.
在那场伟大的斗争中所展示的天资和美德无疑已经预示了其后发生的一切。
例句：Martin's departure is therefore momentous and historic, but may also presage changes to the post, one with which the British public is largely unfamiliar.
马丁的离职重要且具历史意义，但可能也预示着这一职位会有所改变，英国公众对这个职位并不甚熟悉。

omen
音标：英 /'əʊmən/  美 /'omən/
n. 预兆, 征兆
短语：auspicious omen — 吉祥；好兆头
例句：The car won’t start. Do you think it’s an omen?
汽车发动不起来。你觉得这是某种预兆吗？

precognition
音标：英 /,priːkɒg'nɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /,prikɑɡ'nɪʃən/
n. 预知
例句：It's long been regarded as pseudoscience, but precognition–that is, the ability to not just predict but to actually perceive the future–is getting a fair shake in some scientific circles lately.
长期以来，人们一直认为预知是伪科学，但最近在某些科学家圈子里，预知——不仅是预测还包括准确感知未来的能力——开始得到了一定的认可。
例句：It's long been regarded as pseudoscience, but precognition–that is, the ability to not just predict but to actually perceive the future–is getting a fair shake in some scientific circles lately.
长期以来，人们一直认为预知是伪科学，但最近在某些科学家圈子�，预知——不仅是预测还包括准确感知未来的能力——开始得到了一定的认可。
例句：Cornell Professor Daryl Bem conducted nine experiments on more than 1,000 Cornell students to test the human mind powers of premonition and precognition。
康奈尔大学教授达里尔-贝姆对1000多名康奈尔大学学生做了9项实验，以测试人类预感和预知能力。

orexis
音标：英 /ɔː'reksɪs/  美 /o'rɛksɪs/
n. 欲望, [医]食欲
例句：It is my orexis, without any aim.
那只是我心底的欲望，没有任何目的。
例句：Do you feel hungry frequently? Is orexis bloom a good thing?
最近时常感觉饿吗？食欲旺盛是好事吗？

parable
音标：英 /'pærəb(ə)l/  美 /'pærəbl/
n. 寓言, 比喻
例句：...the parable of the Good Samaritan.
…善良的撒玛利亚人的寓言。

horticulture
音标：英 /'hɔːtɪ,kʌltʃə/  美 /'hɔrtɪ'kʌltʃɚ/
n. 园艺
例句：The area has a long tradition of horticulture.
园艺是这个地区源远流长的传统。
例句：Thus, to earn a Plant Science merit badge, a scout can choose between agronomy, horticulture, or field botany.
因此，为了赚取植物科学奖章，一个童子军可以选择农学，园艺，或田野植物学。
例句：All volunteers first go through orientation sessions, which are followed with one of three more specific training tracks:horticulture, “Ambassadors, ” and animal care.
所有的志愿者先要通过新成员训练，然后再在三种特殊训练规划（园艺、“大使”和动物照料）中选择一种。
